children.description: Intercepts each message at every processing step in the route, allowing cross-cutting logic such as logging or auditing

children.name: interceptFrom
children.title: Intercept From
children.description: Intercepts incoming messages arriving from consumer endpoints, optionally filtering by endpoint URI pattern
children.label: configuration

children.name: interceptSendToEndpoint
children.title: Intercept Send To Endpoint
children.description: Intercepts messages being sent to a specific endpoint, allowing the message to be modified or the send to be skipped
children.label: configuration

children.name: onCompletion
children.title: On Completion
children.description: Defines steps to execute when route processing completes, either on success, failure, or both

children.name: onException
children.title: On Exception
children.description: Defines exception handling for specific exception types, with options for redelivery, logging, and routing to error endpoints

children.description: Defines reusable configuration that is automatically applied to matching routes, such as shared error handling or interceptors
children.label: configuration

children.name: route
children.title: Route
children.description: Defines a Camel route that specifies the processing steps a message goes through from a consumer endpoint to one or more producer endpoints
children.label: configuration

children.name: routeTemplate
children.title: Route Template
children.description: Defines a parameterized route template that can be instantiated multiple times with different parameter values
children.label: configuration

children.name: templatedRoute
children.title: Templated Route
children.description: Creates a route instance from a route template, binding specific parameter values to the template's parameters
children.label: configuration

children.name: restConfiguration
children.title: Rest Configuration
children.description: Configures global settings for the REST DSL, such as host, port, context path, binding mode, and the underlying HTTP component to use
children.label: rest

children.title: Rest
children.description: Defines a REST service with HTTP operations (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.) using the Camel REST DSL
children.label: rest

children.title: Transformations
children.description: Container for defining data type transformer definitions
children.label: transformation

children.name: validators
children.title: Validations
children.description: Container for defining data type validator definitions
children.label: validation

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Processing steps that can be used inside a route

children.name: a2aSubTask
children.title: A2A Sub Task
children.description: Groups route steps and emits A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol progress events before, after, or when the grouped work fails
children.label: eip,routing,ai

children.name: aggregate
children.title: Aggregate
children.description: Collects and combines related messages into a single message using a correlation expression and an aggregation strategy. Messages are grouped into buckets by correlation key and released when a completion condition is met.
children.label: aggregate,eip,routing

children.name: bean
children.title: Bean
children.description: Invokes a method on a Java bean, with automatic parameter binding from the message body, headers, and exchange properties
children.label: eip,endpoint

children.name: cache
children.title: Cache
children.description: Caches the result of the nested processing steps. On cache hit, skips the block and sets the body from cache. On cache miss, executes the block and caches the result body.
children.label: eip,routing,caching

children.name: choice
children.title: Choice
children.description: Routes messages to different steps based on a series of conditions (predicates), similar to if-elseif-else in Java. Each condition is evaluated in order until one matches.
children.label: eip,routing

children.name: circuitBreaker
children.title: Circuit Breaker
children.description: Wraps message processing with a circuit breaker for fault tolerance. Prevents cascading failures by short-circuiting calls to an unhealthy service and routing to a fallback
children.label: eip,error,resilience,routing

children.name: claimCheck
children.title: Claim Check
children.description: Temporarily stores the message content and replaces it with a claim check key, allowing the content to be retrieved later in the route. Useful for reducing memory when large payloads pass through processing steps that don't need them.
children.label: eip,enrichment,routing

children.name: convertBodyTo
children.title: Convert Body To
children.description: Converts the message body to a specified Java type using Camel's built-in type converters
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: convertHeaderTo
children.title: Convert Header To
children.description: Converts a message header value to a specified Java type using Camel's built-in type converters
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: convertVariableTo
children.title: Convert Variable To
children.description: Converts a variable value to a specified Java type using Camel's built-in type converters
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: delay
children.title: Delay
children.description: Delays message processing for a specified duration, which can be a fixed value or computed dynamically per message
children.label: eip,flowcontrol,routing

children.name: doCatch
children.title: Do Catch
children.description: Catches specific exceptions within a doTry block, allowing fine-grained exception handling within the route
children.label: error,errorhandling

children.name: doFinally
children.title: Do Finally
children.description: Defines steps to always execute after a doTry block completes, regardless of whether an exception was thrown or caught
children.label: error,errorhandling

children.name: doTry
children.title: Do Try
children.description: Wraps route steps in a try-catch-finally block for fine-grained exception handling within the route
children.label: eip,error,errorhandling,routing

children.name: dynamicRouter
children.title: Dynamic Router
children.description: Routes a message step-by-step through a series of endpoints, determined dynamically by calling an expression repeatedly. The expression is called after each hop and returns the next endpoint, or null to stop.
children.label: eip,routing

children.name: enrich
children.title: Enrich
children.description: Enriches the message with additional data obtained by sending to another endpoint using request-reply. The reply is merged into the original message using an aggregation strategy.
children.label: eip,enrichment,transformation

children.name: filter
children.title: Filter
children.description: Filters messages using a predicate expression. Messages matching the predicate continue processing; non-matching messages are skipped.
children.label: eip,routing

children.name: idempotentConsumer
children.title: Idempotent Consumer
children.description: Filters out duplicate messages based on a unique message identifier and an idempotent repository that tracks previously seen IDs
children.label: eip,flowcontrol,routing

children.name: kamelet
children.title: Kamelet
children.description: Calls a Kamelet (reusable route template) as a step in the route. Normally Kamelets are invoked via kamelet: endpoint URIs; this EIP is for special cases where direct invocation is needed.
children.label: eip,endpoint,routing

children.name: loadBalance
children.title: Load Balance
children.description: Distributes messages across multiple endpoints using a load balancing strategy such as round-robin, random, failover, or weighted
children.label: eip,loadbalancing,routing

children.name: log
children.title: Logger
children.description: Logs a message using an expression that can include message body, headers, and other exchange data
children.label: eip,routing

children.name: loop
children.title: Loop
children.description: Processes the message body repeatedly for a specified number of iterations, or until a condition is met
children.label: eip,flowcontrol,routing

children.name: marshal
children.title: Marshal
children.description: Serializes the message body into a specific data format such as JSON, XML, CSV, or Protobuf for transmission or storage
children.label: eip,dataformat,transformation

children.name: multicast
children.title: Multicast
children.description: Sends a copy of the message to multiple fixed endpoints, processing them sequentially or in parallel, and optionally aggregating their replies
children.label: eip,routing

children.name: pausable
children.title: Pausable
children.description: Pauses a consumer based on a condition, allowing it to be resumed later from the last known offset. Useful for controlling ingestion rate on polling consumers.
children.label: eip,routing

children.name: pipeline
children.title: Pipeline
children.description: Processes the message through a sequence of steps where the output of each step becomes the input of the next
children.label: eip,routing

children.name: policy
children.title: Policy
children.description: Applies a policy to the route, such as a transactional policy or a custom policy for cross-cutting concerns
children.label: configuration

children.name: poll
children.title: Poll
children.description: Polls a single message from a consumer endpoint and sets it as the message body. Useful for fetching data on-demand from file, database, or messaging endpoints.
children.label: eip,enrichment,routing

children.name: pollEnrich
children.title: Poll Enrich
children.description: Enriches the message with additional data obtained by polling a consumer endpoint (such as a file or message queue). The polled data is merged using an aggregation strategy.
children.label: eip,enrichment,transformation

children.name: process
children.title: Process
children.description: Invokes a custom Camel Processor for programmatic message processing in Java
children.label: eip,endpoint

children.name: recipientList
children.title: Recipient List
children.description: Routes a message to a list of dynamically calculated endpoints, determined at runtime from an expression. Each recipient receives a copy of the message.
children.label: eip,routing

children.name: removeHeader
children.title: Remove Header
children.description: Removes a specific header from the message by name
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: removeHeaders
children.title: Remove Headers
children.description: Removes all message headers whose names match a given pattern. Useful for stripping internal Camel headers before sending to external systems.
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: removeProperties
children.title: Remove Properties
children.description: Removes all exchange properties whose names match a given pattern
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: removeProperty
children.title: Remove Property
children.description: Removes a specific exchange property by name
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: removeVariable
children.title: Remove Variable
children.description: Removes a specific variable by name
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: resequence
children.title: Resequence
children.description: Reorders messages based on a sequence expression, either in batch mode (collect and sort) or stream mode (continuous reordering with a timeout)
children.label: eip,flowcontrol,routing

children.name: resumable
children.title: Resumable
children.description: Enables resuming processing from the last known offset after a restart, using a resume strategy to track and restore position
children.label: eip,routing

children.name: rollback
children.title: Rollback
children.description: Forces a rollback of the current transaction and stops routing the message. Can set a custom message on the exception.
children.label: eip,errorhandling,routing

children.name: routingSlip
children.title: Routing Slip
children.description: Routes a message through a pre-determined sequence of endpoints defined in a header or expression (the routing slip). The list of endpoints is evaluated once upfront.
children.label: eip,routing

children.name: saga
children.title: Saga
children.description: Defines a Saga (long-running action) that coordinates distributed services toward a consistent outcome. Unlike XA transactions, Sagas use compensating actions for rollback and work across heterogeneous services.
children.label: eip,routing

children.name: sample
children.title: Sample
children.description: Samples a subset of messages passing through the route, either by frequency count or time interval, and discards the rest
children.label: eip,flowcontrol,routing

children.name: script
children.title: Script
children.description: Executes an expression or script in a chosen language for side effects without modifying the message body
children.label: eip,transformation

children.name: setBody
children.title: Set Body
children.description: Sets the message body to a value computed by an expression
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: setExchangePattern
children.title: Set Exchange Pattern
children.description: Sets the message exchange pattern (MEP) on the exchange, such as InOnly for one-way or InOut for request-reply
children.label: configuration,messaging

children.name: setHeader
children.title: Set Header
children.description: Sets a message header to a value computed by an expression
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: setHeaders
children.title: Set Headers
children.description: Sets multiple message headers at once, each computed by its own expression
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: setProperty
children.title: Set Property
children.description: Sets an exchange property to a value computed by an expression
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: setVariable
children.title: Set Variable
children.description: Sets a variable to a value computed by an expression
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: setVariables
children.title: Set Variables
children.description: Sets multiple variables at once, each computed by its own expression
children.label: eip,messaging,transformation

children.name: sort
children.title: Sort
children.description: Sorts the items in a message body that is a List, using a specified comparator or the default ordering
children.label: eip,transformation

children.name: split
children.title: Split
children.description: Splits a message into multiple sub-messages using an expression, and processes each one individually. Supports parallel processing and result aggregation.
children.label: aggregate,eip,routing

children.name: step
children.title: Step
children.description: Groups a sequence of processing steps under a single logical name for improved monitoring, management, and tracing visibility
children.label: eip,routing

children.name: stop
children.title: Stop
children.description: Stops processing of the current message and marks the exchange as completed without sending it to any further steps
children.label: eip,flowcontrol,routing

children.name: threads
children.title: Threads
children.description: Offloads processing of subsequent steps in the route to a thread pool, enabling asynchronous and concurrent message handling
children.label: eip,flowcontrol,routing

children.name: throttle
children.title: Throttle
children.description: Limits the message throughput to a maximum number of messages per time period to avoid overloading downstream systems
children.label: eip,flowcontrol,routing

children.name: throwException
children.title: Throw Exception
children.description: Throws an exception during route processing, either creating a new exception instance or re-throwing an existing one
children.label: error,errorhandling

children.name: to
children.title: To
children.description: Sends the message to a fixed endpoint URI
children.label: eip,endpoint,routing

children.name: toD
children.title: To D
children.description: Sends the message to an endpoint URI computed dynamically from an expression, allowing the destination to vary per message
children.label: eip,endpoint,routing

children.name: tokenizer
children.title: Specialized tokenizer for AI applications
children.description: Tokenizes the message body for AI processing, splitting text into chunks suitable for embedding or LLM input
children.label: eip,transformation,ai

children.name: transacted
children.title: Transacted
children.description: Wraps the route in a transaction, ensuring that all steps within the transacted block either complete together or roll back on failure
children.label: configuration

children.name: transform
children.title: Transform
children.description: Sets the message body using an expression. Unlike setBody, transform also sets the OUT message body in InOut exchanges
children.label: eip,transformation

children.name: transformDataType
children.title: Transform Data Type
children.description: Transforms the message body between known data types (such as XML, JSON, Java objects) using registered data type transformers
children.label: eip,transformation

children.name: unmarshal
children.title: Unmarshal
children.description: Deserializes the message body from a specific data format such as JSON, XML, CSV, or Protobuf into a Java object
children.label: eip,dataformat,transformation

children.name: validate
children.title: Validate
children.description: Validates the message against a predicate expression and throws a PredicateValidationException if the validation fails
children.label: eip,transformation

children.name: wireTap
children.title: Wire Tap
children.description: Sends a copy of the message to a secondary endpoint without affecting the original route flow. The tapped message is sent asynchronously in a separate thread
children.label: eip,endpoint,routing

children.title: Constant
children.description: A fixed value set only once during the route startup

children.description: Whether to disable this EIP from the route during build time. Once an EIP has been disabled then it cannot be enabled later at runtime.

children.name: correlationExpression
children.description: The expression used to calculate the correlation key to use for aggregation. Exchanges with the same correlation key are aggregated together. If the correlation key cannot be evaluated an Exception is thrown.
children.title: Correlation Expression

children.name: completionPredicate
children.description: A predicate to indicate when an aggregated exchange is complete. If not specified and the AggregationStrategy implements Predicate, it will be used as the completionPredicate.
children.title: Completion Predicate
children.label: advanced

children.name: completionTimeoutExpression
children.description: Time in millis that an aggregated exchange should be inactive before its complete (timeout), evaluated as an expression allowing dynamic timeout values.
children.title: Completion Timeout Expression
children.label: advanced

children.name: completionSizeExpression
children.description: Number of messages aggregated before the aggregation is complete, evaluated as an expression allowing dynamic size values.
children.title: Completion Size Expression
children.label: advanced

children.name: optimisticLockRetryPolicy
children.description: Configures retry settings when using optimistic locking.
children.title: Optimistic Lock Retry Policy
children.label: advanced

children.name: parallelProcessing
children.description: When completed exchanges are sent out of the aggregator, this option indicates whether Camel should use a thread pool with multiple threads for concurrency.
children.title: Parallel Processing

children.name: optimisticLocking
children.description: Turns on optimistic locking, which requires the aggregation repository to implement OptimisticLockingAggregationRepository.
children.title: Optimistic Locking

children.name: optimisticLockingSyncRetry
children.description: When optimistic locking is enabled, retries happen synchronously in the same thread instead of being scheduled on a background thread. This preserves transaction context for repositories that require single-thread transactional guarantees.
children.title: Optimistic Locking Sync Retry
children.label: advanced

children.name: executorService
children.description: Reference to a custom thread pool to use for parallel processing and sending out aggregated exchanges.
children.title: Executor Service
children.label: advanced

children.name: timeoutCheckerExecutorService
children.description: Reference to a custom thread pool for the background completion timeout checker.
children.title: Timeout Checker Executor Service
children.label: advanced

children.name: aggregateController
children.description: Reference to an AggregateController to allow external sources to control this aggregator.
children.title: Aggregate Controller
children.label: advanced

children.name: aggregationRepository
children.description: Reference to the AggregationRepository to use. By default uses MemoryAggregationRepository.
children.title: Aggregation Repository

children.name: aggregationStrategy
children.description: The AggregationStrategy to use. Required. Merges each incoming exchange with the existing already merged exchanges. At first call the oldExchange parameter is null.
children.title: Aggregation Strategy

children.name: aggregationStrategyMethodName
children.description: The method name to use when using a POJO as the AggregationStrategy.
children.title: Aggregation Strategy Method Name
children.label: advanced

children.name: aggregationStrategyMethodAllowNull
children.description: If true then null is used as the oldExchange at the very first aggregation, when using POJOs as the AggregationStrategy.
children.title: Aggregation Strategy Method Allow Null
children.label: advanced

children.name: completionSize
children.description: Number of messages aggregated before the aggregation is complete. Can also be set as an expression via completionSizeExpression.
children.title: Completion Size

children.name: completionInterval
children.description: A repeating period by which the aggregator will complete all current aggregated exchanges. Cannot be used together with completionTimeout.
children.title: Completion Interval

children.name: completionTimeout
children.description: Time that an aggregated exchange should be inactive before its complete (timeout). Cannot be used together with completionInterval.
children.title: Completion Timeout

children.name: completionTimeoutCheckerInterval
children.description: Interval in millis for the background task that checks for completion timeouts. Default is 1000 (1 second).
children.title: Completion Timeout Checker Interval
children.label: advanced

children.name: completionFromBatchConsumer
children.description: Enables batch completion mode where aggregation completes based on the total number of exchanges reported by a batch consumer. Cannot be used together with discardOnAggregationFailure.
children.title: Completion From Batch Consumer
children.label: advanced

children.name: completionOnNewCorrelationGroup
children.description: Enables completion on all previous groups when a new incoming correlation group starts. Only one correlation group can be in progress at a time.
children.title: Completion On New Correlation Group
children.label: advanced

children.name: eagerCheckCompletion
children.description: If enabled then the completion predicate evaluates against the incoming exchange. Otherwise it evaluates against the aggregated exchange.
children.title: Eager Check Completion

children.name: ignoreInvalidCorrelationKeys
children.description: If enabled then a correlation key that cannot be evaluated is logged and ignored, instead of throwing an exception.
children.title: Ignore Invalid Correlation Keys
children.label: advanced

children.name: closeCorrelationKeyOnCompletion
children.description: Closes a correlation key when its complete. Late arriving exchanges with a closed correlation key will throw a ClosedCorrelationKeyException. The value is the maximum cache size of closed keys. Use 0 for unbounded.
children.title: Close Correlation Key On Completion
children.label: advanced

children.name: discardOnCompletionTimeout
children.description: If enabled then the aggregated message is discarded (dropped) on completion timeout instead of being sent out of the aggregator.
children.title: Discard On Completion Timeout
children.label: advanced

children.name: discardOnAggregationFailure
children.description: If enabled then the partly aggregated message is discarded when aggregation failed (an exception was thrown from AggregationStrategy). Cannot be used together with completionFromBatchConsumer.
children.title: Discard On Aggregation Failure
children.label: advanced

children.name: forceCompletionOnStop
children.description: If enabled then all current aggregated exchanges are completed when the context is stopped.
children.title: Force Completion On Stop
children.label: advanced

children.name: completeAllOnStop
children.description: If enabled then waits to complete all current and partial (pending) aggregated exchanges when the context is stopped, ensuring the aggregation repository is empty before shutdown.
children.title: Complete All On Stop
children.label: advanced

children.description: Sets the AggregationStrategy to be used to assemble the replies from the recipients, into a single outgoing message.
children.title: Aggregation Strategy

children.name: aggregationStrategyMethodName
children.description: This option can be used to explicitly declare the method name to use, when using POJOs as the AggregationStrategy.
children.title: Aggregation Strategy Method Name
children.label: advanced

children.name: aggregationStrategyMethodAllowNull
children.description: If this option is false then the aggregate method is not used if there was no data to enrich. If this option is true then null values is used as the oldExchange (when no data to enrich), when using POJOs as the AggregationStrategy.
children.title: Aggregation Strategy Method Allow Null
children.label: advanced

children.name: parallelAggregate
children.description: If enabled then the aggregate method on AggregationStrategy can be called concurrently. Notice that this would require the implementation of AggregationStrategy to be implemented as thread-safe. By default this is false meaning that Camel synchronizes the call to the aggregate method. Though in some use-cases this can be used to archive higher performance when the AggregationStrategy is implemented as thread-safe.
children.title: Parallel Aggregate
children.label: advanced

children.name: parallelProcessing
children.description: If enabled then sending messages to the recipients occurs concurrently. Note the caller thread will still wait until all messages has been fully processed, before it continues.
children.title: Parallel Processing

children.name: synchronous
children.description: Sets whether synchronous processing should be strictly used. When enabled then the same thread is used to continue routing after the recipient list is complete, even if parallel processing is enabled.
children.title: Synchronous

children.name: timeout
children.description: Sets a total timeout specified in millis, when using parallel processing. If the Recipient List hasn't been able to send and process all replies within the given timeframe, then the timeout triggers and the Recipient List breaks out and continues.
children.title: Timeout

children.name: executorService
children.description: Refers to a custom Thread Pool to be used for parallel processing. Notice if you set this option, then parallel processing is automatically implied, and you do not have to enable that option as well.
children.title: Executor Service
children.label: advanced

children.name: stopOnException
children.description: Stops further processing if an exception or failure occurred during processing of an exchange and the caused exception will be thrown.
children.title: Stop On Exception
children.label: advanced

children.name: ignoreInvalidEndpoints
children.description: Whether to ignore an invalid endpoint URI when trying to create a producer with that endpoint.
children.title: Ignore Invalid Endpoints
children.label: advanced

children.name: streaming
children.description: If enabled then Camel will process replies out-of-order, eg in the order they come back. If disabled, Camel will process replies in the same order as defined by the recipient list.
children.title: Streaming
children.label: advanced

children.name: onPrepare
children.description: Uses the Processor when preparing the exchange to be sent. This can be used to deep-clone messages that should be sent, or any custom logic needed before the exchange is sent.
children.title: On Prepare
children.label: advanced

children.name: cacheSize
children.description: Sets the maximum size used by the ProducerCache which is used to cache and reuse producers when uris are reused. Use 0 for default cache size, or -1 to turn cache off.
children.title: Cache Size
children.label: advanced

children.name: shareUnitOfWork
children.description: Shares the UnitOfWork with the parent and each of the sub messages. Recipient List will by default not share unit of work between the parent exchange and each recipient exchange. This means each sub exchange has its own individual unit of work.
children.title: Share Unit Of Work
children.label: advanced

children.name: allowedSchemes
children.description: Sets an optional comma-separated allow-list of component schemes that the dynamic recipient may resolve to (e.g. http,https). When set, a dynamic endpoint whose scheme is not in the list is rejected. This is a defence-in-depth restriction, useful for low-code / Kamelet deployments; by default (unset) any scheme is allowed.

children.description: Configures the failure rate threshold in percentage. If the failure rate is equal or greater than the threshold the CircuitBreaker transitions to open and starts short-circuiting calls.

children.name: permittedNumberOfCallsInHalfOpenState
children.description: Configures the number of permitted calls when the CircuitBreaker is half open.
children.title: Permitted Number Of Calls In Half Open State
children.displayName: Permitted Number Of Calls In Half Open State
children.label: advanced

children.name: throwExceptionWhenHalfOpenOrOpenState
children.description: Whether to throw io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CallNotPermittedException when the call is rejected because the circuit breaker is half open or open.
children.title: Throw Exception When Half Open Or Open State
children.displayName: Throw Exception When Half Open Or Open State

children.name: slidingWindowSize
children.description: Configures the size of the sliding window which is used to record the outcome of calls when the CircuitBreaker is closed. Sliding window can either be count-based or time-based.
children.title: Sliding Window Size

children.name: slidingWindowType
children.description: Configures the type of the sliding window which is used to record the outcome of calls when the CircuitBreaker is closed. Sliding window can either be count-based or time-based.
children.title: Sliding Window Type
children.label: advanced

children.name: slidingWindowSynchronizationStrategy
children.description: Configures the synchronization strategy for the sliding window. LOCK_FREE uses a CAS-based lock-free algorithm for better performance under high concurrency. SYNCHRONIZED uses blocking locks with lower memory allocation.
children.title: Sliding Window Synchronization Strategy
children.label: advanced

children.name: minimumNumberOfCalls
children.description: Configures the minimum number of calls which are required (per sliding window period) before the CircuitBreaker can calculate the error rate.
children.title: Minimum Number Of Calls

children.name: writableStackTraceEnabled
children.description: Enables writable stack traces. When set to false, Exception.getStackTrace returns a zero length array. This may be used to reduce log spam when the circuit breaker is open.
children.title: Writable Stack Trace Enabled
children.label: advanced

children.name: waitDurationInOpenState
children.description: Configures the wait duration which specifies how long the CircuitBreaker should stay open, before it switches to half open. The default is 60 seconds.
children.title: Wait Duration In Open State
children.label: advanced

children.name: automaticTransitionFromOpenToHalfOpenEnabled
children.description: Enables automatic transition from OPEN to HALF_OPEN state once the waitDurationInOpenState has passed.
children.title: Automatic Transition From Open To Half Open Enabled
children.displayName: Automatic Transition From Open To Half Open Enabled
children.label: advanced

children.name: maxWaitDurationInHalfOpenState
children.description: Configures the maximum wait duration which controls how long the CircuitBreaker should stay in Half Open state, before it switches to open. Value 0 means circuit breaker will wait in half open state until all permitted calls have been completed.
children.title: Max Wait Duration In Half Open State
children.displayName: Max Wait Duration In Half Open State
children.label: advanced

children.name: slowCallRateThreshold
children.description: Configures a threshold in percentage. The CircuitBreaker considers a call as slow when the call duration is greater than slowCallDurationThreshold. When the percentage of slow calls is equal or greater the threshold, the CircuitBreaker transitions to open and starts short-circuiting calls.
children.title: Slow Call Rate Threshold
children.label: advanced

children.name: slowCallDurationThreshold
children.description: Configures the duration threshold above which calls are considered as slow and increase the slow calls percentage. The default is 60 seconds.
children.title: Slow Call Duration Threshold
children.label: advanced

children.name: bulkheadEnabled
children.description: Whether bulkhead is enabled or not on the circuit breaker.
children.title: Bulkhead Enabled

children.name: bulkheadMaxConcurrentCalls
children.description: Configures the max amount of concurrent calls the bulkhead will support.
children.title: Bulkhead Max Concurrent Calls

children.name: bulkheadMaxWaitDuration
children.description: Configures a maximum amount of time which the calling thread will wait to enter the bulkhead. The default is 0 (no waiting).
children.title: Bulkhead Max Wait Duration
children.label: advanced

children.name: bulkheadFairCallHandlingEnabled
children.description: Configures whether the bulkhead uses a fair calling strategy. When enabled (default), a fair strategy guarantees the order of incoming requests (FIFO). When disabled, no ordering is guaranteed and may improve throughput.

children.label: advanced

children.name: timeoutEnabled

children.name: timeoutExecutorService
children.description: References to a custom thread pool to use when timeout is enabled (uses ForkJoinPool.commonPool() by default).
children.title: Timeout Executor Service
children.label: advanced

children.name: timeoutDuration
children.description: Configures the thread execution timeout. Default value is 1 second.
children.title: Timeout Duration

children.name: timeoutCancelRunningFuture
children.description: Configures whether cancel is called on the running future. Defaults to true.
children.title: Timeout Cancel Running Future
children.label: advanced
